column1: # The expected builds of .github/workflows/zephyr-main-weekly.yml. THIS FILE IS THE LIST:
# check-results.py fails the job if any row here has no PASS result, and the workflow's
# EXPECT_ROWS must equal the row count here (+1 for the deprecation sweep). See CONTRIBUTING.md
# "Weekly build against Zephyr main" before editing.
# Columns (TAB-separated): name, kind, app, board, sweep, extra cmake args
#   kind   build = must configure, compile and link
#          test  = build, then run zephyr.exe; both PASS lines must be printed
#   sweep  y = this build's EDS translation units go through the deprecation sweep (EDS#524)
#   args   @EDS@ = the EDS checkout; @NATIVE_BOARD@ = the example's own boards/native_sim
#          conf+overlay if it has them, else the generic ones (as ci.yml's zephyr-examples-native);
#          @PRJ_NO_CANARIES@ = the app's prj.conf minus its stack-canary lines (xenvm, see xenvm.conf)
# Every row also gets -DDIAG_SKIP_CODEGEN=ON and -DCONFIG_COMPILER_WARNINGS_AS_ERRORS=y. No row may
# carry a -Wno-error. Nucleo and xenvm rows add -DCONFIG_NEWLIB_LIBC=n -DCONFIG_EDS_REQUIRE_NEWLIB=n
# (Zephyr SDK 1.0.x ships no newlib, #498); that is a documented option, not a warning escape.
